Breakfast / Orange

Avocado toast with a poached egg

Bright orange meets creamy avocado and crisp sourdough.

15 min • Serves 1

Ingredients

1 slice sourdough, ½ avocado, 1 egg. Lemon juice, salt, pepper, microgreens.

How to make it

Toast the sourdough. Mash avocado with a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt. Poach the egg in gently simmering water for 3–4 minutes. Top with pepper and greens.

Lunch / Watermelon

Watermelon feta salad with garlic crostini

Juicy melon and salty feta, with a golden slice of garlic butter toast.

15 min • Serves 2

Ingredients

2 cups watermelon, ⅓ cup feta, 6 basil leaves. Lime, olive oil, 2 slices baguette, butter, garlic.

How to make it

Toss cubed melon with feta, shredded basil, lime juice and a little olive oil. Toast baguette, then spoon over melted butter with chopped garlic cooked until lightly golden.

Happy hour / Black Cherry

A happy-hour snack board

Black cherry balances briny olives, toasty nuts and tangy blue cheese.

10 min • Serves 4

Ingredients

½ cup mixed nuts, ½ cup olives, 3 oz blue cheese. Crackers, olive oil and lemon zest.

How to make it

Toss olives with olive oil and lemon zest. Cube the blue cheese and stack the crackers. Set out the nuts in a small bowl and serve with chilled Aspire Black Cherry.
